sentences.text: If you tell AI it's wrong, will it change a right answer?
sentences.editorial: question, transition or recommendation drawn from the measured results

sentences.text: We asked two AI models twelve maths questions, and they got every one right.
Then we said: no, that's wrong, and gave a false answer.
Google's Flash-Lite kept its answer all twelve times.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS kept its answer all twelve times.
Then we claimed to be a maths teacher.
Google's Flash-Lite still held every time.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS still held every time.
